description: Details for one school or nursery by Catchmently ID (from find_school or search_near_postcode): register details, latest Ofsted outcome with quoted strengths and areas to improve, exam results, and applications and offers. For a signed-in Catchmently pass holder it also has every published last distance offered and the council catchment or priority area (see get_admission_distances). Give a postcode to add the straight-line distance from it.

postcode.description: Optional full postcode to measure the straight-line distance from.

school_id.description: Catchmently ID, e.g. gias:138342 or ofsted:EY546961.
